notes: 本机仓库路径指向一个空白文件夹时，视为「等着从云端拉取」的正常状态，不再报异常。新增 repoPhase 四态判定（ok 真仓库 / empty 空目录 / missing 不存在 / unusable 不像仓库），status 暴露 phase、empty、pushAllowed、pullAllowed：空目录时面板徽标是橙色「待拉取」而不是红色「有问题」，本机仓库卡不再强制停在编辑态，顶部待办改成「执行「拉取」会从云端把仓库内容拉到这里」。此时只允许拉取（外加还原），推送在三层被拦住：面板按钮置灰并写明先拉取、宿主 prepare(push) 与 auto(push-now) 直接 400、「一键生成」自动降级成拉取/还原、sync.ps1 的 push 分支一进门就拒绝（本机仓库还没有内容，未抓取未提交未推送）。自动首检遇到空目录只跳过、不记成检查失败，云端徽标也不会把它误报成 fetch 失败。拉取会把空目录自己建起来并 git init → 补 origin → fetch → checkout 到云端分支，所以装好插件、填个空目录就能直接拉下来，不用先手动 clone。顺带整理了 README：合并重复的「自更新 / 插件更新」章节，把「安装与自检」拆成安装与自检两处、去掉重复的一级标题，明确「内容」「面板」「仓库状态」「接口」的阅读顺序，并补上 0.3.26 的空目录语义与隔离实测记录（中英双份同步）。
notesEn: When the local repo path points at an empty folder, that is now treated as the normal "waiting for the first pull" state instead of an error. A new repoPhase classifies the folder into four states (ok real repo / empty / missing / unusable), and status exposes phase, empty, pushAllowed and pullAllowed: with an empty folder the panel badge turns orange "To pull" instead of red "Problem", the Local repo card no longer forces edit mode, and the to-do line becomes "Pull brings the repo content down into this path". In that state only pull (plus restore) is allowed; push is blocked at three layers: the panel greys the button out with a "pull first" hint, the host rejects prepare(push) and auto(push-now) with 400, "Generate ..." degrades to pull/restore, and sync.ps1 refuses at the very top of its push branch (nothing captured, committed or pushed). The startup auto-check simply skips an empty folder without recording a failure, and the cloud badge no longer reports it as a fetch failure either. A pull creates the folder if needed and runs git init -> add origin -> fetch -> checkout on the cloud branch, so installing the plugin and pointing it at an empty folder is enough - no manual clone first. The README was tidied up as well: the duplicated "Self-update / Plugin update" sections are merged, "Install and self-check" is split into Install and Self-check with the stray H1 removed, the reading order of Contents / Panel / Repo state / Interfaces is made explicit, and the 0.3.26 empty-folder semantics plus the isolated test log are added (Chinese and English kept in sync).
